 PWHL ANNOUNCES LARGEST TAKEOVER TOUR™ TO DATE WITH 24 GAMES ACROSS 19 CITIES
 Share: Loading... Nine cities to host their first Takeover Tour™ games, with the league returning to 10 previous tour markets 
 Tour begins Jan. 2 in Washington, D.C., and concludes April 10 in Philadelphia 
 DoorDash returns as title partner for all eight Canadian Takeover Tour™ games across six cities 
 NEW YORK AND TORONTO (Nov. 19, 2026) — The Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) is embarking on its most expansive Takeover Tour™ to date, featuring a record 24 regular-season games across 19 cities in the United States and Canada. Spanning 99 days from Jan. 2 through April 10, the tour will feature all 12 PWHL teams, with each playing four games.
 The 2026-27 PWHL Takeover Tour begins Saturday, Jan. 2, when the Ottawa Charge face the Boston Fleet at Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C., and concludes Saturday, April 10, with the New York Sirens taking on the Toronto Sceptres at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia.
 “The Takeover Tour gives us the opportunity to bring the energy and excitement of PWHL games to fans beyond our home markets,” said Amy Scheer, PWHL Executive Vice President of Business Operations. “With 24 games across 19 cities this season, we're creating more opportunities for fans to see our players compete, returning to communities that have supported the league while introducing the PWHL to new audiences and strengthening our presence across North America. Through meaningful community engagement surrounding the games, we're inspiring the next generation of players and making hockey more accessible to communities and fans who may not otherwise have the opportunity to experience it.”
 The 2026-27 tour will return to 10 cities that have previously hosted Takeover Tour games: Buffalo, Calgary, Chicago, Denver, Edmonton, Halifax, Québec City, Raleigh, Washington, D.C., and Winnipeg. Nine cities will host their first Takeover Tour games: Columbus, Hartford, Los Angeles, Nashville, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Saskatoon, Sunrise, and Tampa. Pittsburgh previously hosted Toronto and Montréal at PPG Paints Arena during Takeover Weekend in March 2024, ahead of the Takeover Tour launch the following season.
 Several cities will host multiple games this season, led by Halifax with a tour-record three games at Scotiabank Centre. Denver, Philadelphia, and Washington, D.C., will each host two games.
 The expanded schedule builds on the success of the league's first two Takeover Tour seasons, which have welcomed a combined 323,232 fans across 25 games. The 2025-26 PWHL Takeover Tour featured 16 games and attracted nearly 200,000 fans, highlighted by a crowd of 17,228 at Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C., establishing a then-U.S. attendance record for a professional women's hockey game.
 The impact of the Takeover Tour extends well beyond the games themselves, creating meaningful connections with fans and communities through events and experiences. During the 2025-26 Takeover Tour, the PWHL engaged more than 10,000 community members through youth clinics, open practices, autograph sessions, and opportunities for individuals and families to attend games who might otherwise face financial barriers to doing so.
 DoorDash, the official on-demand delivery platform partner of the PWHL in Canada, returns for a second consecutive season as the title partner of all eight Canadian games on the 2026-27 PWHL Takeover Tour. Canadian presenting partners are Lafleur for the game in Québec City, Betty Gaming for the games in Edmonton and Calgary, and Nutrien for the games in Saskatoon and Winnipeg. In the United States, presenting partners are Magellan for the game in Chicago, Woody Creek Distillers for both games in Denver, e.l.f. for the game in Los Angeles, D'Youville University for the game in Buffalo, and Bread Financial for the game in Columbus.
 Tickets for the Jan. 2 game in Washington, D.C. are available for purchase now. Tickets for the remaining PWHL Takeover Tour games will be available starting with presales on Monday, Nov. 23 followed by the general on-sale on Tuesday, Nov. 24 at 10 a.m. local time in host markets. Fans can sign up for the official PWHL newsletter here to receive presale access information. For more information, and to purchase tickets, visit the official PWHL Takeover Tour page here .
